it: Why was John the right collaborator for this project? John’s practice is quite unique. We were familiar with his on-chain generative work as well as his incredible commercial graphic design work, where pixels, rasterization, and generative typography play an important role.

Why was John Provencher the right collaborator for Raster’s logo project?

The idea of having a generative logo, thefunnyguys, goes back to founding Le Random. What’s that story and why did the concept persist to Raster? Le Random exists to celebrate generative art, which we broadly define as systems-based art where the artist cedes some control to randomness. The typical logo creation process is the opposite of that. You agree on one canonical, static asset, which is then never altered and endlessly repeated.
